companyFieldUpdates.description: JFK New Terminal One is the public-private partnership developing and operating a new international terminal at John F. Kennedy International Airport in Queens, New York under a long-term lease through 2060. The approximately $9.5 billion, 2.6 million-square-foot project is designed for 23 gates and roughly 23 million annual passengers. Its current direct sponsor cap table is Ferrovial 49%, JLC Infrastructure 30%, Ullico 19% and Carlyle 2%; Swiss Life Asset Managers separately reports a 0.4% look-through interest through a co-investment vehicle inside JLC's 30% block.
